primaryFixtureStrategy.purpose: Fetch one fixture bundle with result, events, lineups, team statistics and player statistics.

endpointInventory.purpose: Resolve provider league and season identifiers.

Resolve provider player identifiers for the tracked Japanese-player registry.
Coach identity and career-history fallback when a lineup omits coach details.

matchId.strategy: Persist provider fixture id and resolve to a stable JFW matchId.

competition.strategy: Use provider id crosswalk; preserve the provider id.

club.strategy: Resolve the team at the match, not the player's current club.

playerId.strategy: Join through the tracked-player provider-id registry; names are display data only.

appearance.strategy: Combine minutes, lineups and events without interpreting missing as no appearance.

formation.strategy: Persist both teams, their reported formation strings and starting XIs on matchUpdates[].formationData.

lineupGrid.strategy: Persist the provider row:column grid for pitch placement; do not invent a provider grid when omitted.

shirtNumber.strategy: Persist the match-lineup shirt number for display.

playerPhoto.strategy: Prefer a returned HTTPS photo URL; otherwise build the documented public media URL /football/players/{player_id}.png. Display a fallback when the media file is unavailable.

coach.strategy: Persist the head coach with each home/away formation. Prefer a returned HTTPS photo URL; otherwise build /football/coachs/{coach_id}.png.

substitution.strategy: For subst events, treat player as outgoing and assist as incoming; retain elapsed and stoppage time for clear IN/OUT display.

apiFootballRating.strategy: Persist the provider match rating separately from JFW Rating so the UI can compare or switch between them.

goals.strategy: Use exhaustive goal events as the fallback and consistency check. A scorer event must create a playerMatchStats record even when player statistics are absent.

assists.strategy: Use exhaustive goal events as the fallback and consistency check.

passesCompleted.strategy: Map the provider's reported accurate-pass count; retain the raw provider path in the inventory.

shotsOnTargetFaced.strategy: For goalkeepers only, derive saves plus goals conceded when both are known.

cleanSheets.strategy: For an appearing goalkeeper only, derive 1 when provider goals conceded is explicitly zero; otherwise do not guess.

yellowCards.strategy: Use player statistics and exhaustive card events.

secondYellowRed.strategy: Derive only from exhaustive card-event detail.

straightRed.strategy: Derive only from exhaustive card-event detail.

ownGoals.strategy: Own-goal events never increment normal goals.

penaltiesConceded.strategy: Direct numeric mapping using the provider's field spelling.
